title: The European Convention guarantees a fair and public hearing within a reasonable time by an independent and impartial tribunal established by law
summary: The European Convention guarantees a fair and public hearing within a reasonable time by an independent and impartial tribunal established by law.
body: Article 6 states a right, in the determination of civil rights and obligations or of any criminal charge, to a fair and public hearing within a reasonable time by an independent and impartial tribunal established by law, and says judgment shall be pronounced publicly, with stated exceptions. The source says: "In the determination of his civil rights and obligations or of any criminal charge against him, everyone is entitled to a fair and public hearing within a reasonable time by an independent and impartial tribunal established by law." Independent, impartial, established by law, public, and within a reasonable time are the text's conditions. The margin-of-appreciation idea is a later judicial practice and is not a phrase in this sentence.
